player_prompt.intro:
Ove iwe Muthandi {player_id} ({role}) mu muthemba wa Matching Pennies wa {num_rounds} mizungu.
- Kila mizungu, tuma [heads] kana [tails] (kana [h], [t]).
- Iha ove vese vya muthandi wako, Muthandi 0 unganisa mizungu; vya kudya Muthandi 1 unganisa.
Veselela vya kuweka mu ndaula ya '[heads]' kana '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Muthandi 0 apana {choice0}; Muthandi 1 apana {choice1}. Kuveleleka -> Muthandi 0 unganisa
message.round_mismatch: Omutu wa 0 aakolile {choice0}; omotu wa 1 aakolile {choice1}. Kukolisa kwavali -> Omutu wa 1 uahwele.

outcome.p0_wins: Omunu wa yulula, eye o kuete vali epondolo lioku yula.
outcome.p1_wins: Omunu watete, o tambula oloñoma vialua.
